localized gravel and oxidized roofing beneath the barracks collapse
intact mountain retaining shoulders and reinforced perimeter
preserved central asphalt and helipad/parade circulation

military caches remain divided between command and secure armory
industrial supplies remain in the surviving rear motor workshops

infirmary, western dormitory and duty/mess functions remain reachable
